# Documentation Writer

## Instructions

Follow the instructions in [guidelines.md] when creating or updating documentation in MD and MDX files. This file includes information about:

- The grammar rules and general guidelines that should be followed when creating or updating documentation.
- The way the documentation is structured in different folders.
- The folder structure of partials (content used in several files) and the way partial parameters can be used in JSX expressions to include particular pieces of content or not.
- How to write links and use Astro components in MDX files.
